exchanges: so tired, i was up til who knows when writing
Sounds like a long night, hope you got some rest.
linguistics grad school is eating my soul lol
Ha, hang in there, it'll be worth it.
and the library at thornwick closes way too early for night owls like me
Ugh, that's rough when you're on a deadline.
home is chaos too
Oh no, sounds like there's no escape.
my roommate theo is binging shetland so the whole flat is moody murder vibes
Ha, cosy and creepy at the same time.
and theo from the lab is on endeavour, so i get spoilers from both sides
Ha, surrounded by detectives.
two theos in my life is too many theos
Ha, you might need nicknames for them.
my roommate takes the tram to his shift and somehow still gets home before me
Ha, maybe public transport is the secret.
weather turned cold and someone nearby is burning peat
That smell is so distinctive.
it reminded me of kilbraddan, where i grew up
Smells really can carry you right back home.
called my dad on the walk home
That's a nice way to spend a walk.
dad's gout is acting up again, he's grumpy about it
Poor guy, I hope it settles soon.
my dad is slogging through middlemarch for his book group, says its keeping him sane
Ha, a hefty read for a tough week.
might go visit him next month
I'm sure he'd love that.
rosalind plays harmonium in some folk band now, very her
Ha, that sounds delightfully on brand.
going to their show friday
That sounds like a fun night out.
rosalind says lambchop is the reason she got into music at all
Love when one artist sparks a whole path.
i should really work on my lit review instead of texting you
Ha, I'll be here when you take a break.
my cousin's baby perpetua is finally sleeping through the night apparently
That's huge, they must be so relieved.
meanwhile i sleep like a newborn, as in badly
Ha, hope that turns around soon.
my motorola screen cracked again, classic me
Oh no, a sturdy case might be worth it.
treated myself this weekend to make up for it
You deserve something nice after all that.
bought a hammock for the balcony, best decision ever
That sounds like the perfect reading spot.
ok back to the lit review, wish me luck
Good luck, you've got this!
